name: PDFShift
tagline: HTML-to-PDF conversion API with CSS, headers/footers, and sandbox free usage
description: PDFShift converts HTML (or URLs) to PDF via a simple REST API. It supports CSS, headers/footers, sandbox free usage, and various PDF options for generating documents programmatically.

auth.details: API key via HTTP Basic Auth or X-API-Key header after self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan: 50 credits/month; 1 credit per 5 MB of generated output; 15 MB maximum file size; 30-second timeout. Sandbox conversions do not consume credits, include a watermark, and are limited to 10 documents/minute.

rate_limits: 2 requests/minute when unauthenticated; up to 250 documents/minute when authenticated; 10 documents/minute in sandbox mode.

example.request: curl -X POST https://api.pdfshift.io/v3/convert/pdf -H "X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"source": "https://example.com"}' --output document.pdf
example.response_snippet: Binary PDF content (or JSON with base64 when encode is true)

use_cases: convert a web page URL to PDF
generate PDF invoices with custom headers/footers
sandbox-test PDF generation without a paid plan
